critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1054 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth.py, ai.py, payments.py, messaging.py, websocket.py) for maintainability.

extract_json() helper at line 21-34 works but the regex {.*?} won't match nested objects reliably; fallback to text[start:] works because json.loads is tolerant. Consider using a proper bracket-matching parser for robustness.
Compatibility cache lookup uses $or query but never refreshes - if profiles change significantly, stale scores remain. Consider TTL or invalidate-on-profile-update.
Voice message stores entire audio inline as base64 in MongoDB (2MB cap). For production, switch to object storage (S3/GCS) with signed URLs to avoid bloating mongo and chat history payload size.
WebSocket ChatManager is in-memory only - won't scale across multiple backend instances. For production, use Redis pub/sub.
Subscription pricing is hardcoded; missing Stripe price IDs - the emergent StripeCheckout abstracts this but a real Stripe integration usually maps plan_id -> Stripe Price/Product IDs.
WS endpoint does not validate match.status == 'matched' nor handles unmatched scenario explicitly - currently allows any user in match.user1_id/user2_id even if status='unmatched'.
No rate limiting on AI endpoints (date-ideas/icebreakers/compatibility) - could be expensive if abused.
